card.name: Commas in lists of garden plants
card.fires_on: Commas between plant names in lists of wildflowers or garden perennials, such as Aster, Bee Balm, Day Lily. Also 'such as' before plant names.

modes.label: Commas in plant lists
modes.description: The comma that follows a plant name inside a list of flowers or perennials.
modes.example: Recommended perennials include Aster, Bee Balm, Day Lily, Foxglove, Globe Thistle, Hollyhock, Lupine<<,>> Milkweed, and Phlox.

modes.description: A linking word such as 'as' that introduces plants or plant parts in nature writing.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the next plant name in the list, such as Aster-like or sedge-like names, though the promoted tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It fires on the commas in a list of flower or plant names, getting ready for the next plant in the list.
